title: Lecture Notes on Bundles and Connections
institution: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin (author-hosted); written for MIT 18.950, Spring 2007
description: Book-in-progress (last updated 26 September 2008) written as the text for the second half of MIT's 18.950 Differential Geometry: connections motivated from Riemannian geometry and physics; fibre, vector and principal bundles; connections (parallel transport, connections on fibre, vector and principal bundles); natural constructions on vector bundles; curvature on bundles; curvature in Riemannian geometry (locally flat manifolds, hypersurfaces and Gaussian curvature, the Gauss–Bonnet formula, geodesics and sectional curvature); appendices on multilinear algebra and Lie groups. Chapters are separate PDFs.
rightsNotes: The page states: 'These notes can be used for any noncommercial purpose without my explicit permission'. The copyright page of each chapter states: '© 2008 by Chris Wendl. Paper or electronic copies for noncommercial use may be made freely without explicit permission from the author. All other rights reserved.' This is an explicit non-commercial permission, not a formal licence; Corniversity is private and non-commercial and records it as such.
Used in MAT-262 as an open alternative for connections, curvature and Gauss–Bonnet alongside the primary notes.
